rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who makes a living buying and selling goods.

example.english: He has been in the dried-seafood business for years and is a trader who knows how to buy and sell.
example.traditional: 佢做咗好多年海味生意，係個識買識賣嘅商人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 hoi2 mei2 saang1 ji3 hai6 go3 sik1 maai5 sik1 maai6 ge3 soeng1 jan4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a professional who trades securities or other financial instruments.

example.english: My friend works as a trader at a bank, buying and selling stocks every day.
example.traditional: 我朋友喺銀行做交易員，日日睇住個市買賣股票。
